sources.label: Blackmagic ATEM Camera Control Panel technical specifications
sources.scope: Product identity, four LCDs/joysticks/preview buttons, Ethernet/USB-C and power.

sources.label: Blackmagic ATEM manual · Camera Control Panel
sources.scope: CCU strip functions, scene files, camera settings, color balance, joystick iris/master black, panel setup.

sources.label: Blackmagic physical specification drawing
sources.scope: 430 × 389 × 141.7 mm external envelope and chassis profile.

sources.label: DB | FMP | AV Gear · ATEM Camera Control Panel
sources.scope: FMP hardware identity, labels, ownership, use and Camera 1 control-loss history.

sources.label: REF | FMP | Signal Flow
sources.scope: Panel → ATEM Ethernet control, then camera control rides the return path to Cameras 1–3; P240 is separate.

components.label: ATEM Camera Control Panel chassis
components.purpose: Desktop four-strip camera shading/control panel.
components.limits: Envelope follows manufacturer physical drawing; bevels and radii are approximate.

components.label: IEC AC input
components.purpose: Internal 100–240 V AC input
components.limits: Manufacturer rear drawing establishes connector type and relative placement.

components.label: 4-pin XLR DC input
components.purpose: 12–30 V DC redundant input
components.limits: Manufacturer rear drawing establishes connector type and relative placement.

components.label: Ethernet 1
components.purpose: 10/100/1000 BaseT network/control
components.limits: Manufacturer rear drawing establishes connector type and relative placement.

components.label: Ethernet loop
components.purpose: Second GigE port for loop output
components.limits: Manufacturer rear drawing establishes connector type and relative placement.

components.label: USB-C service
components.purpose: Firmware updates
components.limits: Manufacturer rear drawing establishes connector type and relative placement.

components.label: Panel → ATEM control network
components.purpose: Camera-control commands leave the panel over Ethernet and reach the ATEM.
components.limits: Exact switch port and live addressing are not embedded.

components.label: ATEM → URSA SDI return/control
components.purpose: ATEM embeds camera-control data in the return path to Blackmagic cameras.
components.limits: At FMP this path applies to the URSA camera chains. The BirdDog P240 uses its separate SuperJoy/VISCA path.
